46975.hook: A priest carried off to Babylon becomes the strangest visionary of a shattered nation.

46976.hook: Arrian's history of Alexander the Great opens with Philip's death and the young king's wars against the Thracians and Thebes.

46977.hook: A wartime engineer argues workers deserve a reward for efficiency, not another round of the old wage war.

46978.hook: A missionary's daughter spends the summer with an unknown aunt in a house full of secrets.

46982.hook: A young Parisian defends a composer she has never heard of, and spends her life following him.

46983.hook: A sacred white elephant recounts his own life: worship, war, exile, and one beloved princess.

46984.hook: Thirty-four birth-stories of the Buddha, each a small parable of impossible generosity.

46986.hook: A freethinker cross-examines every scrap of evidence for the Gospel story and dares the reader to follow.

46988.hook: Grandfather Frog explains how the creatures of the meadow won their gifts long ago.

46989.hook: A sergeant who stormed the Alma tells war from the ranks, frostbite, bayonets, and all.

46990.hook: A former slave-ship sailor turns his firsthand horror at the trade into a searing poetic indictment.

46992.hook: Three unsparing French plays put marriage, motherhood and respectability on trial before the audience.

46994.hook: Everything about the pear, its lore, history and hundreds of varieties, in one lavish monograph.

46998.hook: An Enlightenment chemist leads absolute beginners from air, water, earth, and fire to the secrets of matter.
